articles.title: Eli Lilly Stock Surges to Record High Amid Expanded Commercial PBM and Pharmacy Coverage for Zepbound
articles.summary: Eli Lilly's stock reached an all-time high driven by reports of expanded commercial coverage, including moves by major PBMs and pharmacies like CVS to include the weight-loss drug Zepbound on formulary lists. This development matters because broader commercial inclusion accelerates patient access to high-cost specialty anti-obesity medications within employer-sponsored plans. For self-funded employers and benefit managers, this trend underscores the escalating financial pressure of managing surging GLP-1 utilization and necessitates tighter utilization management strategies to control plan costs.

articles.title: WashU Expert Analysis Suggests FTC Settlements May Fail To Curb Pharmacy Benefit Manager Practices
articles.summary: Recent Federal Trade Commission (FTC) settlements involving major pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) may prove insufficient in fundamentally altering industry practices or lowering drug costs, according to legal and healthcare experts. For self-funded employers, this signals that relying solely on federal regulatory enforcement will not solve PBM transparency and pricing challenges, reinforcing the need for proactive contract management and independent oversight to control pharmacy spend.
